---
title: Options override theme defaults
# Colours are hex strings (escaped by Pandoc)
linkcolor: "#0066cc"
citecolor: "#cc0000"
filecolor: "#008800"
number-sections: true
format:
  preprint-typst:
    keep-typ: true
    theme: jou
    fontsize: 14pt
    columns: 1
---

`theme: jou` sets two columns and 10pt text, but this document asks for one column and 14pt text, which must win.

# Link colours {#sec-intro}

An external [link](https://quarto.org) should be blue (#0066cc), an internal [link](#sec-intro) green, and the cross-references @sec-intro and @eq-x red.

$$
x = y
$$ {#eq-x}
